instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Update 'tailwind.config.js' and 'index.css' immediately with the provided color palette. Force Dark Mode.
3. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to 'index.css' and update font families in tailwind config.
4. LAYOUT: Use the 'Bento' grid strategy for the Dashboard. Avoid equal-width columns. Create density.
5. COMPONENTS: Customize all Shadcn components to remove 'rounded-md' and replace with 'rounded-sm' or 'rounded-lg' as per guidelines. Remove default blue rings.
6. IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash URLs. Do not use placeholders.
7. PRO FEATURES: Any feature labeled 'PRO' must use the Accent Gold color (#D4AF37) for its icon or border.
8. MAPS: If a map is needed, use a dark-themed map style (e.g., Mapbox Dark) or a placeholder div with the 'texture_bg' image and a grid overlay.
9. TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
